Because of that, someone who spins up 41 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 151 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1482 identities would post 3443 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
